page.notes: The right side of the page is cut off, so several entries and references end short at the edge (for example "donatium, donat", "dormitare, dorm", "dulcedo, dulcesc", "duplicare, duplu"). A blot covers the start of the entry after "dominus", so its letters are illegible. "dominire", "dorsum" and "minium" are uncertain readings: the long s and the blurred letters could not be read with certainty. The left edge of the column is partly cut away, so the first letters of some lines are missing or uncertain. "I N I[?]" is the visible top line of a header; its last letter is uncertain. The "53[?]" reading is doubtful: the last digit is unclear. The "er[?]" fragment is uncertain. The line with the large initial E carries the number 421, which may belong to that initial line rather than to Ebenum lignum; placement doubtful. "ebullitiones" and "ebullire" are read from a small scan and may be misread.
